why: Capture real coverage before changing parser or approval semantics

decision: Select immutable case receipts and advisory baseline
why: Public projects lack trusted approvals; separate event truth and policy controls

decision: Freeze first 30 eligible projects and 90 pairs before replay
why: Preserve selection exclusions and prevent tuning on checker outcomes

decision: Require source-path remapping in the release recipe
why: Two clean path-varied builds differed; remapped binary and archive bytes matched
result: local repeatability verified; independent operator and runtime floor remain open

decision: Start with self-pilots in our own projects
why: User confirmed no external maintainers are enrolled and asked to pilot ourselves
result: self-pilot authorized; external maintainer evidence deferred

decision: Repair measurement bugs before trusting public scores
why: Independent verifier demonstrated missing-fact, wrong-addition and descendant-timeout holes
result: repair in progress; full public baseline not yet accepted

decision: Create persistent goal for the complete qualification phase
why: User explicitly asked to set a goal and continue until accomplished

decision: Correct legacy archive root semantics before final baseline scoring
why: Scripts-disabled npm installs prove ordinary @types archives use one stripped root; old oracle left them unknown
result: partial original run retained; restart baseline after oracle correction

decision: Reuse two loader-owned buffers before changing accepted inputs
why: Native profiling showed retained empty allocator regions; the smaller design avoids a cache or inspector object
result: A selected 24/25 versus B 16/25; implementation waits for complete M1 accounting

decision: Seal all 90 unchanged core executions; reject a product qualification claim
why: Every result is incomplete; exact inputs, outputs, protocol and implementation hashes were independently audited
result: raw measurement VERIFIED; event score waits for comparator repair

decision: Correct absent-value and exact artifact-digest comparisons before accepting scores
why: Independent development labels exposed false misses and a difference-only artifact comparison loophole
result: separate repair and immutable-output rescore in progress

decision: Preserve an invalid Unicode escape accepted by the unchanged CLI
why: JSON permits four hexadecimal digits after the escape; numeric conversion accepted a plus sign
result: invalid JSON accepted with complete exit 0; focused repair queued after M1

decision: Freeze development measurements before selecting cumulative limits
why: Actual decompressed bytes and repeated failures bound work more reliably than gzip size footers
result: 121 snapshots measured; independent census review PASS; capped expansion remains a lower bound
